summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TCIS Nexus Outlook-style mail system. Backend APIs working excellently (95.5% success rate), 3-column layout functioning correctly, but ReactQuill integration has compatibility issues preventing compose functionality.

flaky_endpoints.workaround: Endpoint may have different path or not implemented

ui_bugs.issue: ReactQuill throwing runtime error: 'react_dom_1.default.findDOMMode is not a function'

integration_issues.issue: Compose dialog opens but crashes due to ReactQuill errors, preventing message composition
Reply, Reply All, Forward buttons not consistently visible in thread view

passed_tests: Mail folders (Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Archive, Trash) all present
Folder navigation between all 5 system folders
Thread clicking and reading pane integration
Search input field present and functional
Mail system accessible to all user roles
Backend mail APIs: folders, contacts, threads, send, reply, archive (all working)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix ReactQuill integration compatibility issues in ComposeDialog component. The rich text editor is causing runtime errors that prevent compose functionality. Consider updating ReactQuill version or implementing error boundary.
